tasks.old_behavior: No --releasever-major or --releasever-minor CLI options existed. Users could only override $releasever via --releasever.
tasks.new_behavior: Two new CLI options --releasever-major and --releasever-minor allow overriding $releasever_major and $releasever_minor variables independently.
tasks.compatibility_reason: New CLI options are additive and backward-compatible (default=None). However, they introduce new public CLI surface that could conflict with custom wrapper scripts or plugin argument names, and the releasever_major/minor config values can now be set independently of --releasever, changing the semantics of variable substitution in repo files.
tasks.test_recommendation: Test that --releasever-major and --releasever-minor correctly override $releasever_major and $releasever_minor in repo variable substitution. Test interaction with --releasever (e.g., --releasever=40 --releasever-major=5 should set releasever=40, releasever_major=5, releasever_minor=detected). Test with --releasever=/ (detect from root).

tasks.old_behavior: _read_conf_file(self, releasever=None) - called as self._read_conf_file(opts.releasever) passing 1 argument.
tasks.new_behavior: _read_conf_file(self, releasever=None, releasever_major=None, releasever_minor=None) - called as self._read_conf_file(opts.releasever, opts.releasever_major, opts.releasever_minor) passing 3 arguments.
tasks.compatibility_reason: The call site in Cli.configure() now passes 3 positional arguments. Any plugin or subclass that overrides _read_conf_file with the old signature (self, releasever=None) will receive a TypeError at runtime when configure() calls _read_conf_file with 3 arguments. Although _read_conf_file is _-prefixed (private by convention), DNF's plugin architecture allows plugins to interact with the Cli class.
tasks.test_recommendation: Create a minimal test harness that subclasses Cli, overrides _read_conf_file with old signature, and verifies that configure() call does not raise TypeError. This validates the practical compatibility impact.

tasks.old_behavior: conf.releasever, conf.releasever_major, conf.releasever_minor were only set when releasever is not None after detection. Conditional assignment via if-blocks.
tasks.new_behavior: conf.releasever, conf.releasever_major, conf.releasever_minor are always assigned using or_else priority helper: CLI value > auto-detected > existing config value.
tasks.compatibility_reason: The restructuring is functionally equivalent for all backward-compatible input combinations. Both code paths produce identical config values in all existing usage scenarios. The only net-new behavior is when --releasever-major or --releasever-minor are explicitly provided (covered by PCA-0001).
tasks.test_recommendation: Covered by PCA-0001 testing. No additional standalone testing needed for this restructuring.
